activities.activity: Sleeping, with the fan running against the warm night air
Waking up, washing face and brushing teeth
Preparing and eating a quick breakfast, drinking water to hydrate for the hot day
Getting dressed in light work clothes, packing bag and checking phone for messages
Commuting to the nonprofit office in the already-hot morning
Working at the nonprofit office on community program coordination, planning sessions and answering emails
Taking a lunch break nearby and eating lunch, staying in the shade
Continuing work at the office, meeting community partners and updating program schedules
Commuting home during the peak heat of the evening
Cooking a simple dinner and eating it
Washing dishes and tidying up the kitchen
Relaxing in the living room with the fan only, keeping the air conditioner off during the grid peak period
Watching TV and catching up on the phone with the air conditioner on after the peak window ends
Taking a cool shower and completing evening hygiene routine
Preparing for bed, setting the fan and dimming the desk lamp
